messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective"
set: ["this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "taking more than your recommended dose will not make this medicine more effective", "is normal", "make the medication less appealing to children and pets", "these can make your body absorb less of the medicine", "tests can help your doctor determine if this medicine is effective", "will not be as effective in lowering cholesterol", "it is not effective for glycemic control", "tell your doctor if your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "this is the reason for the recommendation", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "make sure all of the mixture is taken", "even if blood sugar is normal", "talk with your doctor if you think your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "3 mg dose is not effective for glycemic control", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:
